method: Six preregistered synthetic football tasks. The one-model baseline is frozen from the pre-improvement run with its original Azure receipt. The production crew arm uses the current BTR source-rendered five-role output. Four blinded evaluator passes independently score both arms on anchored five-point criteria and reverse A/B order by case. Each published artifact contains one complete scoring set; technical recaptures must be disclosed beside the artifact.

evidence_limit: Model-scored comparison over six synthetic cases and twenty-four order-reversed paired decisions. It tests this release on correction, audience fit, role distinction and decision usefulness; it is not an independent human study or proof across all football commentary. Microsoft Foundry remains the separate live release referee.
capture_note: The first successful execution printed to an output-limited terminal and could not be retained in full. It scored 93–90 overall, 93–89 grounding and 95–91 decision usefulness. The same unchanged image and procedure were run once more solely to capture this complete artifact; the recapture scored 94–90, 91–87 and 96–92. Both aggregates favor the crew, but neither is an independent human study.
